synth.notes:
Two-axis 3x3-block mirror game (x=row): model = H row-axis, V col-axis, pieces as block sets, selection (read from 0 centres), target blocks; A5 cycles H->V->pieces by (min row,min col).
A1/A2 move H or the selected piece by rows, A3/A4 move V or the piece by cols; bounds only for axes, pieces also blocked by other pieces.
Each piece casts a visible gray mirror across V plus invisible erasing mirrors across H and across both; layered composite (piece>vis refl>inv refl>target(solid)>V>H) then re-extract by colour (walls/players over own+0 cells, refl ranked over vis+inv, targets merged at bbox gap<=4).
Missed mechanic (step 268): a piece touching the H axis row gets an INVISIBLE V-mirror instead of the gray one (whole piece); ablating it fails only step 268.
Stateless (no hidden counter/turn order needed); counter object never changes. Unconfirmed: A5 order for >2 pieces, intersection-only selection.
